rules.reason: Primary accuracy is not improved and predeclared fresh-test CKA is weak despite low minibatch geometry loss. Check fit versus input generalization without further training.
rules.models: All six exact initializations and all thirty selected/final models; no selection or parameter changes.
rules.features: Task-free ONE_END, frozen inverse teacher. All conditions use the identical geometry-eligible training rows; validation uses every row.
rules.comparison: Report full train/validation CKA and a matched-count comparison using the first 12 eligible train, first 12 validation and first 12 fresh test rows per length. Equal count avoids treating the sample-size bias of linear CKA as fit generalization.
rules.aggregate: Five lengths averaged equally; retain every replicate and endpoint. Fit accuracy uses all 192 train labels; validation uses 64.
rules.scope: Implementation and overfitting diagnostic, not a new confirmatory hypothesis or hyperparameter search.
